description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans silos, specifically testing behavior during ungraceful silo shutdowns and their impact on grain requests. It includes configuration of silo and client options, setup of test clusters, and a test method that kills a silo to verify request handling behavior.

classes.name: SilosStopTests
classes.description: A test class that sets up a test cluster for Orleans silos and contains a test method to verify silo shutdown behavior and request handling.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with custom silo and client configurators.

methods.name: SiloUngracefulShutdown_OutstandingRequestsBreak
methods.description: Unit test that kills a secondary silo ungracefully and checks if outstanding requests throw SiloUnavailableException.

methods.name: GetGrainOnTargetSilo
methods.description: Helper method that attempts to obtain a grain located on a specific silo, retrying if necessary.
